description: Install dependencies and verify baseline. Set up pnpm install, ensure lint/typecheck/build pass on current placeholder code.
steps: Run `pnpm install` in the workspace root to install all dependencies
Run `pnpm run lint` and fix any issues with the placeholder code
Run `pnpm run typecheck` and fix any TypeScript errors in placeholder files
Run `pnpm run build` and ensure it passes (currently just tsc for packages)
Verify all existing workspace packages resolve correctly
acceptance_criteria: `pnpm run lint` passes with no errors
`pnpm run typecheck` passes for all packages
